title: Electricity Depth: Circuits and Electronics
summary: A reference path from circuit structure and measurement to electronic components, motors, and controlled power.
outcome: Build the circuit intuition and measurement discipline needed to reason about practical electronics without treating diagrams or formulas as magic.

modules.title: Series and parallel circuits
modules.description: Learn how current paths, voltage drops, and equivalent resistance change when components share one path or branch across several paths.

modules.title: Circuit measurement
modules.description: Measure voltage, current, resistance, and continuity while understanding reference points, meter placement, uncertainty, and safe limits.

modules.title: Kirchhoff’s laws
modules.description: Use conservation of charge and energy to analyze circuits with multiple nodes, branches, sources, and loops.

modules.title: Capacitors and inductors
modules.description: See how electric and magnetic fields store energy, oppose sudden change, and shape circuit behavior over time.

modules.title: Diodes and transistors
modules.description: Move from passive networks to components that steer, switch, and control electrical signals and power.

modules.title: Motors and power electronics
modules.description: Connect electromagnetic force to motion, then learn how switching circuits regulate motors, voltage, current, and heat.
